CW.Title: Wounds
CW.MinorFull: No minor wound slots remained, so the wound escalated to moderate.
CW.ModerateFull: No moderate wound slots remained, so the wound escalated to major.
CW.MajorFull: All major wound slots are filled.
CW.ModerateThreshold: Filling the final moderate wound hinders all actions by one step.
CW.MajorThreshold: Each major wound hinders all actions by one step.
CW.Settings.Inject.Name: Show wound strip on sheets
CW.Settings.Inject.Hint: Adds a compact wound tracker to the top of character sheets.
CW.Settings.Chat.Name: Announce changes in chat
CW.Settings.Chat.Hint: Posts to chat whenever a wound is taken or healed.
CW.Settings.Defeated.Name: Mark token defeated on death
CW.Settings.Defeated.Hint: Marks active tokens defeated when the last major slot is filled.
CW.Settings.Players.Name: Owners can edit their characters
CW.Settings.Players.Hint: Allows owners to use the wound tracker without being GM.
CW.Settings.TokenHUD.Name: Show Token HUD button
CW.Settings.TokenHUD.Hint: Adds a wound shortcut to the Token HUD.
CW.NoPermission: You do not have permission to alter this actor's wounds.
CW.InvalidActor: Select a token or open a character sheet.
C2T.GMOnly: Only the GM can import content.
C2T.Importer.Title: Cypher 2 Toolkit — Importer
C2T.Importer.MenuHint: Imports types, foci, abilities, and journals from a private JSON file into world compendiums.
C2T.Importer.Intro: Choose a structured JSON file. The module creates world compendiums for Types, Foci, Abilities, and Journals. The file is not uploaded to GitHub.
C2T.Importer.FileHint: The file may contain types, foci, abilities, skills, cyphers, and journals.
C2T.Importer.ModeHint: Update preserves unmanaged entries. Replace removes only entries previously imported by the Toolkit.
C2T.Importer.PrefixHint: Use letters and numbers. Example: cypher-2.
C2T.Importer.InvalidRoot: The JSON root must be an object.
C2T.Importer.MustBeArray: the collection must be an array.
C2T.Importer.MissingName: every entry must have a name.
C2T.PlayerIntrusions.GmApproval: Use this only when the situation is appropriate and the GM agrees.
C2T.PlayerIntrusions.NotEnoughXp: {actor} does not have 1 XP to use this Player Intrusion.
C2T.PlayerIntrusions.UseHint: Use this Player Intrusion for 1 XP
CW.ConfigureBaseHint: These are the base limits. Bonuses from Types, Foci, and Abilities on the actor are added automatically.
CW.Settings.TokenCircles.Name: Show wound circles on tokens
CW.Settings.TokenCircles.Hint: Displays all three tracks as circles below the token without using resource bars.
CW.Settings.TokenVisibility.Name: Token circle visibility
CW.Settings.TokenVisibility.Hint: Controls who can see wound circles.
CW.Settings.AutoHinder.Name: Prefill wound hindrance in rolls
CW.Settings.AutoHinder.Hint: Adjusts the initial eased/hindered fields without replacing the system roll engine.
C2T.Resources.SelectTarget: Select or target a player character, NPC, or creature.
C2T.Resources.SelectPcForWounds: Select a player character to alter wounds.
C2T.Resources.WoundButtonHint: {severity}: click to add; Shift-click to remove
C2T.Resources.Settings.Panel.Name: Show resources in the wound panel
C2T.Resources.Settings.Panel.Hint: Shows PC XP and Pools plus Health and essential attributes for NPCs and creatures without adding editing controls.
C2T.Resources.Settings.Audit.Name: Notify GMs about resource changes
C2T.Resources.Settings.Audit.Hint: Creates a private GM-only chat message when a monitored Actor resource changes.
C2T.RandomPC.ButtonHint: Draw a PC from the scene; Shift-click chooses the participants
C2T.RandomPC.None: There are no visible, undefeated PCs in this scene.
C2T.RandomPC.DialogIntro: Choose which characters take part in this draw.
C2T.Recovery.UnexpectedError: The recovery action could not be completed. Check the console for details.
C2T.Recovery.RallyIntro: You can remove a wound by spending Might points. Narratively, rallying represents shrugging it off, toughing it out, catching your breath, or discovering that it was not as bad as it first seemed.
C2T.Recovery.RallyEdge: Might Edge does not reduce the cost of rallying.
C2T.Recovery.NoSelectedWound: This character does not have a wound of the selected severity.
C2T.Recovery.NotEnoughMight: Rallying costs {cost} Might, but only {current} is available.
C2T.Recovery.RallyComplete: Rallying completed: {cost} Might spent and one wound removed.
C2T.Recovery.NoMatchingWound: There was no matching wound to remove.
C2T.Recovery.TreatmentIntro: You can remove a wound by treating it with an Intellect task. The Healing skill is relevant. The roll uses the Cypher System roll dialog, so Effort, assets, and other modifiers can be applied normally.
C2T.Recovery.HealingPrefilled: Healing was found on the sheet and will be prefilled as {level}.
C2T.Recovery.HealingNotFound: No Healing skill was found on the sheet; the task starts as Practiced.
C2T.Recovery.TreatmentFailed: The task failed; the wound was not removed.
C2T.Recovery.RecoveryIntro: PCs begin with four recoveries each day: one action, ten minutes, one hour, and ten hours. They can be used in any order.
C2T.Recovery.RecoveryPools: When a recovery is completed, roll 1d6 plus tier and divide the recovered points among the stat Pools.
C2T.Recovery.LastActionEffect: As a Last Action, add +2 to the roll
C2T.Recovery.OneHourEffect: Remove one moderate wound or all minor wounds
C2T.Recovery.TenHourEffect: Remove all moderate wounds; other choices are available
C2T.Recovery.RecoveryComplete: {recovery} recovery used. Divide the rolled points among the Pools.
C2T.Recovery.OneHourChoice: Choose the wound benefit for this recovery. The selected recovery is consumed only after you choose.
C2T.Recovery.TenHourChoice: Choose the normal or alternative wound benefit for this recovery.
C2T.Recovery.TenHourMajorNote: After the normal benefit, a character with a Major Wound may attempt a difficulty 6 Might task to remove one Major Wound.
C2T.Recovery.TenHourAlternativeDetail: Remove all Minor Wounds, but leave one Moderate Wound untreated
C2T.Recovery.MajorRecoveryIntro: The ten-hour recovery is complete. You may now attempt a Might task to remove one Major Wound; this does not consume another recovery.
C2T.Recovery.AttemptMajor: Attempt to remove one Major Wound
C2T.Recovery.DistributionHint: Allocate up to the rolled total. Points cannot raise a Pool above its maximum, and unused points may be left over.
C2T.Recovery.DistributionChanged: The available capacity of {pool} changed. Review the distribution and try again.
C2T.Recovery.DistributionOverLimit: The distribution cannot exceed the rolled limit of {points} points.
C2T.Opportunities.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Cypher Opportunity Assistant
C2T.Opportunities.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Adds a private, context-aware non-manifest cypher assistant to the GM chat sidebar.
C2T.Opportunities.Title: Cypher Opportunities
C2T.Opportunities.Intro: Choose the current scene contexts. Suggestions favor matching cyphers and avoid recent repetitions.
C2T.Opportunities.SearchPlaceholder: Search by name, effect, or narrative situation...
C2T.Opportunities.NoActiveScene: Activate a scene to create an opportunity plan.
C2T.Opportunities.NoScenePlan: This scene plan is empty. Add cyphers from Suggestions, Catalog, or search.
C2T.Opportunities.PlanDialogHint: Prepare this opportunity for {scene}. Every field below is optional.
C2T.Opportunities.PlanAdded: {cypher} was added to the plan for {scene}.
C2T.Opportunities.NarrativeFallback: An unexpected change in the scene creates an opportunity the character can exploit.
C2T.Opportunities.NoEffectSummary: Open the Item to consult its full effect.
C2T.Opportunities.DistributeSceneHint: Each PC with an active player in the scene receives a matching cypher automatically. Cyphers will not repeat in this distribution.
C2T.Opportunities.DraftSceneHint: Each PC with an active player in the scene receives three matching options and may choose one.
C2T.Opportunities.NoScenePlayers: There are no visible PCs with active players in the current scene.
C2T.Opportunities.NotEnoughUnique: This distribution needs {needed} different cyphers, but only {available} are available for that scene type.
C2T.Opportunities.NotEnoughDraft: At least 3 available cyphers are needed to build the choices; {available} were found.
C2T.Opportunities.DraftsSent: {count} {context} choice set(s) were sent to the players.
C2T.Opportunities.DraftDialogHint: Choose one of three cyphers suited to the {context} context. Only the selected option will be added to the sheet.
C2T.Opportunities.DraftChoiceError: The choice could not be completed. Ask the GM to send it again.
C2T.Opportunities.ItemNotFound: The matching cypher Item was not found. Refresh the catalog or check its name.
C2T.Opportunities.Reminder: Remember to offer {cypher} to {actor} when the fiction allows it.
C2T.Opportunities.DirectDeliveryHint: The cypher will be added to the sheet immediately and the player will be notified.
C2T.Opportunities.CatalogRefreshed: Cypher catalog refreshed: {count} matching Items found.
C2T.Opportunities.Unavailable: The Cypher Opportunity Assistant is not available yet.
C2T.Opportunities.NarrativePlaceholder: Optional: describe the opening, coincidence, or opportunity that emerged in the scene...
C2T.Opportunities.NoActiveGm: An active GM is required to complete this action.
C2T.Opportunities.LinkToChat: Use or post the cypher to chat
C2T.Opportunities.UseAndDiscard: Use and remove this opportunity from the sheet
C2T.Opportunities.UsedAndRemoved: {cypher} was used and removed from the sheet.
C2T.Opportunities.Migrated: {count} legacy opportunity item(s) were updated to the disposable format.
C2T.Opportunities.LimitExceeded: {actor} carries {count} cyphers, but their limit is {limit}. They must discard {excess} or confirm that they will remain over the limit.
C2T.Opportunities.LimitDialogIntro: You carry {count} cyphers with a limit of {limit}. Select at least {excess} to discard or choose to remain over the limit.
C2T.Opportunities.ChooseEnough: Select at least {excess} cyphers to discard.
C2T.Opportunities.KeptOverLimit: {user} chose to keep all {count} cyphers carried by {actor}, over the limit of {limit}.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Combat: A sudden opening, surge of resolve, or shift in the fight could make {cypher} feel like a natural consequence of the action.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Defense: A narrow escape or instinctive reaction could reveal {cypher} at the exact moment the character needs protection.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Social: A change in tone, unexpected empathy, or social misstep could present {cypher} as a fleeting interpersonal opportunity.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Stealth: A distraction, overlooked detail, or brief lapse in attention could naturally create the opportunity for {cypher}.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Exploration: Something discovered in the environment could turn {cypher} into insight, good fortune, or an improvised advantage.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Chase: Momentum, desperation, or a fortunate route could manifest {cypher} during the pursuit or escape.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Recovery: A breath, memory, second wind, or moment of care could make {cypher} emerge from the character's own resilience.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Knowledge: A remembered fact, sudden connection, or overlooked clue could be the fictional expression of {cypher}.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Survival: The environment, instinct, or timely preparation could provide {cypher} as a way through the immediate danger.
C2T.Opportunities.Prompt.Dramatic: At a decisive beat, luck or narrative momentum could offer {cypher} without requiring a physical object.
C2T.Combat.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Combat Assistant
C2T.Combat.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Enables round declarations, Fast/Normal/Last ordering, and turn reminders.
C2T.Combat.Settings.Declarations.Name: Ask about Fast Action and Last Action
C2T.Combat.Settings.Declarations.Hint: Asks each player for their action in an individual popup at the start of the round and orders turns without replacing rolled initiative.
C2T.Combat.Settings.Npcs.Name: Include NPCs in declarations
C2T.Combat.Settings.Npcs.Hint: Lets the GM choose Fast, Normal, or Last for NPCs. Disabled by default to keep play moving.
C2T.Combat.Settings.Reminders.Name: Post start-of-turn reminder
C2T.Combat.Settings.Reminders.Hint: Shows the active character, action category, and a discreet wound summary in chat.
C2T.Combat.DeclarationIntro: Monitor the declarations. Pending answers are treated as Normal when resolved.
C2T.Combat.CharacterDeclarationIntro: Choose when the character acts. The selected button immediately confirms the declaration.
C2T.Combat.NoParticipants: There are no eligible participants this round.
C2T.Combat.NoActiveGm: An active GM is required to record this choice.
C2T.Icons.Title: Icon Manager
C2T.Icons.Intro: Match Opportunity Cyphers, Manifest Cyphers, and Artifacts with icons already bundled with Foundry. Suggestions use each Item's name and can be replaced manually.
C2T.Icons.MenuHint: Suggests, selects, and applies Foundry's bundled icons to world cyphers and artifacts.
C2T.Icons.Propagate: Also update copies on actor sheets
C2T.Icons.NoItems: No Items were found in this category.
C2T.Icons.SafeHint: Only checked rows are changed. Existing custom images are unchecked by default.
C2T.Icons.NothingSelected: Select at least one Item with a defined icon.
C2T.Icons.Applied: Applied icons to {items} source Items and {actors} copies on actor sheets.
